title: ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners
abstract: arXiv:2611.32529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final

translated_title: ContinualDrive：一个面向学习型驾驶规划器持续更新的、以部署为锚点的多轴基准测试
translated_abstract: 学习型驾驶规划器在部署后会随着新驾驶日志的到来而不断更新，然而持续学习评估很少追问一次更新是否真正优于已部署的模型，且其结论往往依赖于未明示的评估选择。我们提出ContinualDrive，一个面向驾驶规划器部署后持续学习的、以部署为锚点的基准测试。该基准基于真实世界的nuPlan日志，每次针对一类场景类型组对已部署规划器进行更新，在开环与闭环两种模式下评估相同的模型检查点，明确给出四个测量轴（评估回路、参考检查点、时间聚合与数据流协议），并将三值化的发布判定锚定于已部署的检查点。我们在三种任务顺序下，研究了两个规划器在完整微调以及适配器或LoRA更新下的表现，并对比了有无回放或梯度投影的情况。研究发现，当任一测量轴改变时，判定结果可能逆转甚至消失：开环ADE对最终检查点
tldr: 该论文提出ContinualDrive基准，以已部署模型为锚点评估驾驶规划器的部署后持续学习，并揭示评估回路、参考检查点、时间聚合和流协议这四个测量轴的选择会显著改变甚至逆转更新效果的判定结论。
en_tdlr: ContinualDrive is a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners, revealing that release verdicts can reverse or vanish as any of four explicit measurement axes changes.
